question: Why is every thing identified as Śiva possessing consciousness and the powers of will and others?
premises: Śiva is of the nature of consciousness.
Śiva possesses will and the other powers.
All things are grounded in this conscious, powerful reality.
inference: Every thing is Śiva, as consciousness endowed with will and the other powers.
plain_english: Thus every thing is Śiva, whose form is consciousness and who possesses will and the other powers.
